story_clips.heygen_prompt: Photorealistic documentary-style vertical shot, shot on a 35 mm lens, early morning in a rural Telangana village: an elderly Indian grandmother in a faded cotton saree, natural skin texture with pores and fine wrinkles, walks barefoot along a red-soil field path carrying a steel bowl of fresh green leafy vegetables, a tiled-roof house and a neem tree behind her, then sits on a low stool and pats jonna rotte (jowar flatbread) by hand on a wooden board beside a wood-fire chulha. Medium-wide shot, face not in close-up, nobody talking to camera, hands busy. Soft golden morning light, slight handheld camera slowly pushing in, shallow depth of field. No text, no logos, no plastic-looking skin, no extra fingers.
